verdict.rationale: PostHog's own docs say you can save insights to dashboards, share them, and "get alerted when they move." PostHog AI can also create alerts. That covers the alerting half of the story, but the evidence shows neither dashboard subscriptions (recurring scheduled reports) nor detection of abnormal movement as opposed to simple change alerts. Missing for 10: documented dashboard subscriptions or scheduled delivery, anomaly-detection alerting on abnormal metric moves, alert configuration depth (thresholds, channels for insight alerts), independent or hands-on corroboration.
